sentences.text: Learned Senior counsel for the appellant submits that the maximum punishment awarded to the appellant is seven years rigorous imprisonment and he has suffered two years of incarceration.
5. Considering the fact that seven years of rigorous imprisonment awarded to him, nature of the case, I am not inclined to grant bail to the appellant.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail is rejected.
However, the appellant may renew his prayer for bail after three years of incarceration.
